abilities.name: Sword Strike
abilities.desc: A sword strike in a cone in front of the hero.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.desc: A wide swing: damage, a slow, and a knockback in a cone.

abilities.name: Hero's Leap
abilities.desc: Leap to a target location; damage along the way, and on landing, damage, a stun, and a knock-up.

abilities.name: Iron Will
abilities.desc: A shield and a speed boost for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Annihilation
abilities.desc: After a short delay, a strike in an area: heavy damage, a stun, and a knock-up.

heroes.about: A heavily armored knight with a sword and shield. Cleave knocks enemies back, Hero's Leap throws him into the thick of the fight, and Iron Will shields him. Annihilation drops from the sky onto an area and decides team fights.
tips: Jump into a group of enemies with Hero's Leap, then use Cleave to knock them back toward your allies.
Activate Iron Will right before trading blows, not after.
Annihilation lands after 0.9 s: aim where the enemy will be.

abilities.name: Blood Blade
abilities.desc: A quick slash in a cone in front of her.

abilities.name: Dark Leap
abilities.desc: Dash toward the reticle, damaging enemies along the way.

abilities.name: Shadow Daggers
abilities.desc: A fan of three daggers; each one hits the first enemy struck.

abilities.name: Siphoning Blades
abilities.desc: Healing, a shield, and a speed boost.

abilities.name: Bloody Execution
abilities.desc: A long dash; on landing, heavy damage, a stun, and a knockback.

heroes.about: A swift vampire who dashes to her target and drains its life. Dark Leap is a damaging dash, Shadow Daggers hit from range, Siphoning Blades heal her in a fight, and Bloody Execution finishes off weakened enemies.
tips: Hunt down lone Marksmen and Mages.
Bloody Execution deals the most damage to low-health targets.
You're exposed after dashing in: save Siphoning Blades for the fight.

abilities.name: Cosmic Bolt
abilities.desc: A bolt of power that flies straight; hits the first enemy struck.

abilities.name: Rift
abilities.desc: After a short delay, an explosion at the target location.

abilities.name: Burden
abilities.desc: A projectile that explodes on impact: area damage, a slow, and a knockback.

abilities.name: Displacement
abilities.desc: Instantly teleport toward the reticle.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.desc: After a short delay, a black hole: massive damage, a stun, and a knock-up in a large area.

heroes.about: A sorcerer of space who deals massive area damage. Cosmic Bolt damages from range, Rift strikes a chosen location, Burden knocks back anyone it hits, and Displacement moves him to safety. Black Hole crushes the entire enemy team.
tips: Fight from range, behind your allies' line.
Rift and Black Hole land with a delay: aim where the enemy is heading.
Save Displacement for an escape.

abilities.name: Arrow
abilities.desc: A quick arrow; hits the first enemy struck.

abilities.name: Explosive Arrow
abilities.desc: An arrow that arcs through the air and explodes on impact: damage, a knockback, and a knock-up.

abilities.name: Backstep
abilities.desc: Hop backward.

abilities.name: Inner Fire
abilities.desc: Faster attacks and movement for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Rain of Arrows
abilities.desc: After a short delay, a rain of arrows in the area: damage and a heavy slow.

heroes.about: The Archer with the longest range on the team. Her arrows damage from afar, Explosive Arrow arcs down and knocks enemies back, Backstep saves her from trouble, and Inner Fire speeds up her attacks. Rain of Arrows blankets the whole area.
tips: Keep your distance: Backstep moves you away from danger.
Explosive Arrow lands exactly where you aim: good against an enemy behind cover.
Activate Inner Fire when shooting a target that can't escape.

abilities.name: Jade Sword
abilities.desc: A sword strike in a cone in front of the hero.

abilities.name: Strike of Light
abilities.desc: A strike of light in a wide cone: damage, a slow, and a knockback.

abilities.name: Sword Throw
abilities.desc: A dash with the sword; damages, stuns, and knocks up enemies along the way.

abilities.name: Guardian's Shield
abilities.desc: A shield for the weakest ally in range (or for himself).

abilities.name: Wrath of Heaven
abilities.desc: After a short delay, the wrath of heaven: heavy damage, a stun, and a knock-up in the area.

heroes.about: A versatile swordsman who wields the power of light. Strike of Light knocks enemies back, Sword Throw carries him to his target, Guardian's Shield protects the weakest ally, and Wrath of Heaven strikes the enemy team with lightning.
tips: Use Sword Throw to catch up to a fleeing enemy.
Guardian's Shield saves an ally who's low on health.
Wrath of Heaven covers a large area: use it in the middle of a team fight.

abilities.name: Rocket Fists
abilities.desc: A series of punches in a cone in front of the hero.

abilities.name: Hook
abilities.desc: A fist thrown on a chain; damages and stuns the first enemy it hits.

abilities.name: Cross Charge
abilities.desc: A rocket-powered charge; damages enemies along the way, ending in an area strike with a knockback.

abilities.name: Uppercut
abilities.desc: A powerful blow from below: damage, a brief stun, and a knock-up.

abilities.name: Rocket Hook
abilities.desc: An empowered fist flies down the entire lane: heavy damage and a stun to everyone it hits.

heroes.about: A cybernetic wrestler with rocket-powered fists. Hook stuns an enemy from range, Cross Charge drives him into the thick of the fight, and Uppercut launches his opponent into the air. Rocket Hook flies down the entire enemy line and stuns everyone it hits.
tips: Start with Hook: a stunned enemy won't escape Cross Charge.
Uppercut knocks the enemy up: use it when they're standing right next to you.
Rocket Hook flies straight and pierces everyone: aim it along the enemy line.

abilities.name: Fire Bolt
abilities.desc: A fireball that flies straight; hits the first enemy struck.

abilities.name: Molotov Cocktail
abilities.desc: The bottle lands after a short delay: damage and a slow in the area.

abilities.name: Oil Slick
abilities.desc: Slide across spilled oil: a big speed boost for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Fire Turret
abilities.desc: The thrown turret breathes fire after a short delay: damage and a knockback in the area.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.desc: Scorch breathes fire down the entire lane: massive damage and a slow to everyone it hits.

heroes.about: A mad goblin and his fiery lizard, masters of setting the battlefield ablaze. Molotov Cocktail sets a chosen spot on fire, Fire Turret knocks back anyone who gets close, and Oil Slick lets them escape. Scorch's Fire Breath burns through the entire enemy line.
tips: Throw Molotov Cocktail at the feet of enemies fighting your allies.
The turret breathes fire after a short delay: place it where the enemy has to pass.
Save Oil Slick for an escape: you're very fragile up close.

abilities.name: Claws
abilities.desc: A quick claw slash in a cone in front of the hero.

abilities.name: Rending Leap
abilities.desc: A leap at the enemy; damages along the way, and deals area damage on landing.

abilities.name: Blade Throw
abilities.desc: The thrown blade damages and slows the first enemy it hits.

abilities.name: Beast Rage
abilities.desc: Faster attacks and movement for a few seconds, plus healing.

abilities.name: Unleashed Fury
abilities.desc: A long leap; on landing, heavy area damage, a stun, and a knock-up.

heroes.about: A demonic beast that hunts the weakened. Rending Leap carries him onto his target, Blade Throw slows those fleeing, and Beast Rage speeds up his strikes and heals him. Unleashed Fury is a long leap ending in a powerful blow to the enemy team.
tips: Only jump in with Rending Leap once the enemy has used their escape.
Activate Beast Rage right before a string of attacks: faster hits and healing.
Use Blade Throw to slow a fleeing enemy before you catch up to them.

abilities.name: Daggers
abilities.desc: The thrown dagger flies straight; hits the first enemy struck.

abilities.name: Doll's Curse
abilities.desc: A cursed pin: damage and a slow to the first enemy it hits.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.desc: After a short delay, a swarm of insects at the target location: damage and a slow.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.desc: Healing and a speed boost for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Spectral Swarm
abilities.desc: After a short delay, a spectral swarm covers a large area: massive damage and a heavy slow.

heroes.about: A swamp witch, mistress of insects and curses. Daggers damage from afar, Doll's Curse slows whoever it hits, Swarm floods a chosen area with insects, and Life Drain heals and speeds her up. Spectral Swarm devours everything in a large area.
tips: Doll's Curse travels slowly: aim ahead of a running enemy.
Swarm lands after a short delay: throw it where the enemy is heading.
Life Drain heals and speeds you up: save it for an escape.

abilities.name: Revolver
abilities.desc: A quick revolver shot; hits the first enemy struck.

abilities.name: Mark
abilities.desc: A ghostly projectile explodes on impact: damage and a stun in a small area.

abilities.name: Obliteration
abilities.desc: A heavy projectile: heavy damage, a slow, and a knockback to the first enemy it hits.

abilities.name: Reload
abilities.desc: Faster shots and movement for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Last Shot
abilities.desc: A projectile with immense range pierces everyone in the lane: massive damage.

heroes.about: An undead gunslinger who returned from the grave for revenge. Revolver damages from afar, Mark stuns whoever it hits, Obliteration slows and knocks back with a heavy round, and Reload speeds up his shooting. Last Shot pierces the entire enemy line from an immense distance.
tips: Shoot from range, behind your allies' line.
Activate Reload when shooting a target that can't escape.
Last Shot has immense range: use it to finish off a fleeing enemy.

abilities.name: Soul Hammer
abilities.desc: A heavy hammer swing in a wide cone in front of the hero.

abilities.name: Siphoning Hand
abilities.desc: A spectral hand rips out a soul: damage and a slow to the first enemy it hits.

abilities.name: Subjugate
abilities.desc: After a short delay, a wave of power at the target location: damage, a stun, and a knock-up.

abilities.name: Surge
abilities.desc: A shield, healing, and a speed boost for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Harvest
abilities.desc: A massive hammer swing: heavy damage, a stun, and a knockback in a wide cone.

heroes.about: A lord of souls with a massive hammer. Siphoning Hand grabs souls from range and slows them, Subjugate stuns and knocks up everyone in the area, and Surge grants him a shield and a speed boost. Harvest is a powerful swing that knocks back the entire enemy team.
tips: Close the gap with Surge, then stun the group with Subjugate.
Use Siphoning Hand to slow an enemy fleeing from your allies.
Harvest knocks back: position yourself so enemies fly toward your team.

items.name: Executioner's Blade
items.passiveText: Execute: +25% damage to enemies below 35% health.

items.name: Blade of Infinity
items.passiveText: Infinity: critical hits deal 225% instead of 175%.

items.name: Bloodthirster
items.passiveText: Satiate: healing above full health grants a shield (up to 200).

items.name: Falconer's Bow
items.passiveText: Arrowhead: every basic attack deals +25 damage.

items.name: Sorcerer's Blade
items.passiveText: Blade Spell: after using an ability, your next basic attack (within 6 s) deals +100% power. Cooldown 1.5 s.

items.name: Sage's Hourglass
items.passiveText: Echo: a basic attack that hits a hero reduces ability cooldowns by 0.5 s.

items.name: Titan's Armor
items.passiveText: Thorns: reflects 20% of basic attack damage back to the attacker.

items.name: Guardian's Aegis
items.passiveText: Last Bastion: below 30% health, gain a shield for 25% of max health. Cooldown 60 s.

items.name: Giant's Heart
items.passiveText: Regeneration: after 5 s without taking damage, restore 3% of max health per second.
